context: Request: the latest Labor & Employment matter where the firm agreed equity-vesting acceleration terms, and the document setting them out. Rubric: 1017-00004 (Aurelius Media), its executed aldrich-settlement-agreement-execution.docx (Section 3(a)), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for request keywords; the hit list spans many matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Lists the store folder and runs find | grep over file paths for request keywords.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads agreements, a memo and an email from three matters whose file names matched; nothing from the other grep-hit matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Content greps inside three candidate matters plus two reads in one of them (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of two agreements and three emails of the two matters it is weighing.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter and a draft agreement as the latest precedent.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The matter it needed appeared in its first two searches, but it opened only matters whose file names matched and named a draft agreement from another matter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its first grep and its file-name search both listed the matter it needed, but it chose to open only matters whose file names matched and never read that matter.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a glob of the empty output folder.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two content greps with single-extension globs (documents, emails); both return nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of agreements and memos from the two matters at the top of the listing; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a later section of one agreement.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a draft agreement from a listing-top matter as the latest precedent, qualified by its draft status.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Both greps returned nothing; it read only the matters at the top of the listing and named a draft agreement from one of them.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Both greps used single-extension globs and returned nothing; it neither retried with another pattern nor searched file names, and fell back to the matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for request keywords.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists matter folders to depth two.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content-mode grep for request keywords, showing matching lines across matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of four candidate matters in one shell loop.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the closing memos of three candidates and an executed agreement of one.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads two emails and the rest of the closing memo of the matter it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter and its executed agreement as the latest precedent.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → List matter folders → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three runs opened with a store-wide grep. T2 followed with a content-mode grep showing matching lines, listed the files of four candidate matters including the needed one, and compared their closing memos by date. T0's grep and file-name search also listed the needed matter, but it opened only matters whose file names matched and named a draft from another matter (surfaced, never opened). T1's greps used single-extension globs and returned nothing; it read the matters at the top of the listing (search miss).
